name: aim-gap-8way
description: CONTROL for the CP2 aim-control complaint, mechanized: sprint into the dare pocket, stop on the pocket floor about 4 tiles short of the aim-bench houndframe (?hound=aim parks one there with its fuse pulled, so this is a target range, not a fight), and hold fire for 2.5s while perfectly lined up and in no danger. Expected: ~20 shots, ZERO kills — the standing firing line (muzzle 1.05 over the deck) passes over the hound's hit circle (0.03-0.87), and the only 8-way alternative, the down-diagonal, buries itself in the deck within a tile. Pairs with aim-gap-crouch.json and aim-gap-assist.json, which differ ONLY by their flag.
